tool_args.rationale: The acquired long-horizon measurements reveal endogenous reversal, while the short-horizon response saturates with u. Fit the identifiable reduced saturating dual-horizon law numerically; the sink factor is omitted because s_grad is zero in every row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its added rows show the predicted transition from positive short-horizon response to negative response near the target horizon.
The eight rows span short and long horizons and exhibit a clear saturating gain and reversal; no further trajectory data is needed before fitting.
It is irrelevant to the observed horizon-dependent response and explicitly should not be purchased.
Short-horizon y/u varies substantially across u, supporting a saturating fast component rather than a purely linear response.
All observed s_grad values are zero, so its sink coefficient is unidentifiable and unnecessary for these data.
